title: Coding students in a school trust
body: A trust runs a number of schools (never more than 99) and wants a 10-digit code for every student so that details can be read from the code itself. Following the hierarchy Trust -> School -> Entry-year -> Stream -> Class -> Section -> Student, its accountant fixes this coding structure, in this order: School 2 digits; Entry-year (last two digits of the year the student entered the current class) 2 digits; Stream 1 digit (0 = not applicable, 1 = Science, 2 = Commerce, 3 = General); Class 2 digits; Section 1 digit (1 = A, 2 = B, 3 = C, and so on, never more than 9 sections); Student roll number 2 digits (never more than 99 students in a section). No digit is kept for the Trust, because there is only one trust.
